description: A CVE in CISA KEV now or removed from it. A CVE never listed gets the tool error KEV entry not found.

in_kev.description: false for an entry CISA removed from the catalog.

patch_deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD by which US federal agencies must patch, or empty.

notes.description: CISA's free text, often URLs, or empty.

date_removed.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ the KEV sync found it gone from CISA's feed. Empty while listed.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
